spectra: Figure 1. Mean absorption and refractive-index spectra for the 300 Suanzaoren TRAIN specimens. Each line represents the mean of 60 specimens from one recorded source group. Absorption is shown on the original exported scale, and refractive index is dimensionless. Frequency follows the recorded THz axis.
budget: Figure 2. Effect of total retained predictor count on five-source Suanzaoren classification. (A) Mean accuracy across three pooled fivefold evaluations of the same 300 TRAIN specimens. The displayed methods use MC20 coefficient-stability selection followed by an RBF SVM, with eligible classifier settings selected within inner folds. K is the total final predictor count, including both blocks for the joint candidate pool. (B) Joint SNV candidate pool minus SNV absorption accuracy. Error bars are exploratory 95% percentile intervals from 5,000 specimen-cluster bootstrap draws (seed 20261109); resampling retains all three paired predictions for each specimen. Intervals are not multiplicity adjusted. The fixed-K analyses are sensitivity comparisons and do not replace the inner-selected primary results. Full results for all stored representations are provided in the supplementary data.
modality: Figure 3. Final predictor composition after joint SNV candidate selection. (A) Absorption and refractive-index occurrences across 15 outer refits at each total predictor budget. Fractions above bars give refractive-index occurrences divided by 15K. All 930 final predictor occurrences at K=62 belong to absorption. (B) Mean Jaccard overlap between the absorption coordinates retained by the joint-pool and absorption-only SNV procedures, calculated within each outer refit and averaged over the 15 refits. At K=62, the mean Jaccard index is 0.0111. Occurrences count predictor selections and are not independent measurements or distinct specimens.
adaptation: Figure 4. Support-label and preprocessing interventions in five-source Suanzaoren classification. Points show internal Query accuracy; the dashed line marks the source-only model (80.00%). Full pipeline refitting with valid labels achieved 83.89%, compared with 83.78% with the Source scaler and kernel scale frozen, 80.11% after updating unlabelled Support statistics, 73.33% with cyclically incorrect Support labels and 83.78% with normalized total loss mass. Each context contains 190 Source, 50 Support and 60 Query specimens; 10 Support labels per class supplies 50 additional labels where applicable. Three partition seeds and five folds reuse the same 300 TRAIN specimens, producing 900 correlated Query predictions. These are internal comparisons, and no confidence interval is plotted.
